name: flowplan-app
description: Flowplan as an app for iPhone, iPad and Android
author: Flowplan

scripts.check: node --check scripts/icons.mjs && node --check scripts/version.mjs && node --check scripts/screenshots.mjs && node --check scripts/store-images.mjs && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.version: node scripts/version.mjs && git add ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj android/app/build.gradle
scripts.ios: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
